notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hi chefs!

Today’s update for Abra-Cooking-Dabra brings to the demo localisations for the following languages:

French

German

Italian

Spanish

Portuguese

Japanese

Korean

Chinese Simplified

Chinese Traditional

Turkish

Additionally, multiple fixes were made for the existing English and Russian localisations.

Enjoy and happy cooking!


Yours, the Door 407 dev team

notes.title: Demo Hotfix is Live
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed, Abra-Cooking-Dabra received some updates - but what they are about? It's simple: they bring the following improvements: 

Improved coins piling

Better grid interactions and dragging

Polished interactions with the trash can

Added zoom lock for the trash can and refrigerators

Additional minor fixes and improvements

 Have a nice time cooking! 

Yours, the Door 407 dev team
